about: Fixtures for the release-please/breaking-change-intact rule and for the release-please
behavior its advice describes. Each entry holds a message as a list of lines (joined
with newlines, with a trailing newline), the verdict the rule must give, the ADVICE
key the failure message must contain, and, when present, the BREAKING CHANGE entries
release-please publishes for the message. An entry with a `todo` names a known
defect: its test runs but does not fail the suite until the defect is fixed.

fixtures.name: a plain paragraph passes
a paragraph followed by a Closes footer passes
the hyphenated BREAKING-CHANGE token passes
a message without a BREAKING CHANGE paragraph passes without parsing
message: Git.clone(url, File.join(dir, name)) now expands the path.
